title: Gibbons calls in Pandolfi to brief on the Rockefeller Initiative

plain: A researcher named Grant Cameron, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in the 1990s John Gibbons, President Clinton's science adviser, called in a CIA scientist named Ron Pandolfi to give a briefing. The briefing was for the Rockefeller Initiative, a push by the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller to get the White House to release what it knew about UFOs. Cameron says it is established that Pandolfi was the one chosen, which would mean UFO questions reached the president's own advisers.
